title: Frame
description: A first-class frame, explicitly attached to exactly one of a body, a joint, a component, or an interface.

body.description: Id of the body this frame is attached to.

joint.description: Id of the joint this frame is attached to.

component.description: Id of the component this frame is attached to.

interface.description: Id of the interface this frame is attached to.

transform.description: The relative pose of this frame with respect to its attachment point.

metadata.description: Opaque, application-defined data carried alongside this frame.
